battlefield.name: Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth
battlefield.contextNotes: played this turn, after Blood Moon was on the battlefield

question: Player 2's Blood Moon was already out when I played Urborg this turn. Does my Urborg tap for black, and does it turn my other lands into Swamps?

expected.shortAnswer: No to both: Blood Moon applies first by dependency, so Urborg is just a Mountain.
expected.answer: No to both. Both cards change land types, which happens in layer 4 (613.1d). Urborg's effect depends on Blood Moon's, since Blood Moon removes Urborg's ability (613.8a), so Blood Moon applies first even though your Urborg arrived later (613.8b). Your Urborg becomes a Mountain and loses the abilities from its rules text (305.7): it taps for red, not black, and it makes no land a Swamp.

whyHard: Timestamp order says Urborg applies last, but Urborg's effect depends on Blood Moon's, so dependency reverses the order inside layer 4 and Urborg never makes a Swamp.
